tools.description:
Retrieves the selectable, filterable, and sortable fields for a specific Google Ads resource,
including compatible metrics and segments.

Use this tool to find out which fields you can select, filter by, or sort by
when querying a specific resource (e.g., 'campaign', 'ad_group').
This tool also returns metrics and segments that can be selected with the resource.
Their names start with 'metrics.' and 'segments.' respectively.

Do not guess fields, you MUST use this tool to discover them before constructing a query for the
`search` tool.

The responses of this tool should be cached, as they don't change frequently.

login_customer_id.description: Optional manager customer ID to use as the login-customer-id header.

resource_name.description: The name of the Google Ads resource (e.g., 'campaign', 'ad_group').

tools.description:
Creates, updates or removes any Google Ads resources in one atomic request.

Wraps GoogleAdsService.Mutate, which supports every mutable resource
(campaigns, budgets, ad groups, ads, keywords, criteria, assets, asset
groups, labels, conversion actions, bidding strategies, shared sets,
experiments, user lists and more).

Each item in `operations` is a MutateOperation with exactly one key named
`<resource>_operation` (snake_case), holding one of `create`, `update` or
`remove`. Field names are snake_case and enums are their string names.
Updates must include `update_mask` listing the changed field paths.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to change (digits only).

login_customer_id.description:
Optional manager customer ID to use as the
login-customer-id header.

operations.description: The MutateOperation objects to apply, in order.

partial_failure.description:
If True, apply the valid operations and report errors
for the rest instead of failing the whole request.

response_content_type.description:
RESOURCE_NAME_ONLY (default) or
MUTABLE_RESOURCE to return the full resources after the change.

validate_only.description: If True, validate the request but do not apply it.

tools.title: Mutate Mutate

tools.description:
Permanently removes resources by resource name.

Works for any removable resource, e.g. `customers/123/campaigns/456`,
`customers/123/adGroups/789`, `customers/123/adGroupAds/789~111`,
`customers/123/adGroupCriteria/789~222`, `customers/123/campaignCriteria/456~333`,
`customers/123/labels/444`. Removed campaigns, ad groups and ads cannot be
re-enabled. To stop serving temporarily, pause instead.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer that owns the resources.

partial_failure.description: If True, remove what can be removed and report the rest.

validate_only.description: If True, validate the request but do not apply it.

tools.description:
Fetches data from the Google Ads API using the search method

    Args:
        customer_id: The id of the customer
        fields: The fields to fetch
        resource: The resource to return fields from
        conditions: List of conditions to filter the data, combined using AND clauses
        orderings: How the data is ordered
        limit: The maximum number of rows to return
        login_customer_id: Optional manager customer ID to use as the login-customer-id header.

    

### Hints
    Language Grammar can be found at https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/query/grammar
    All resources and descriptions are found at https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/fields/latest/overview
    If the query fails, a ToolError will be raised with the error details.

    For Conversion issues try looking in offline_conversion_upload_conversion_action_summary

### Hint for customer_id
    should be a string of numbers without punctuation
    if presented in the form 123-456-7890 remove the hyphens and use 1234567890

### Hints for Dates
    All dates should be in the form YYYY-MM-DD and must include the dashes (-)
    Date ranges must be finite and must include a start and end date

### Hints for limits
    Requests to resource change_event must specify a LIMIT of less than or equal to 10000

### Hints for conversions questions
    https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/conversions/upload-summaries 


### Hints for all resources
    To find out which specific fields (including compatible metrics and segments) you can select, filter by, or sort by for a given resource, you MUST use the `get_resource_metadata` tool.
    Do not guess the fields. Use the tool to look them up.
    Once you have the fields, ensure the whole field name is used (e.g., 'campaign.id', not just 'id'). Wildcards and partial fields are not allowed.

    What follows is a list of valid resources that can be queried.

tools.description:
Calls any Google Ads API service method with a raw request.

Use this only when no dedicated tool fits, for example:
ConversionUploadService.upload_click_conversions,
ConversionAdjustmentUploadService.upload_conversion_adjustments,
OfflineUserDataJobService (Customer Match), UserDataService,
ReachPlanService.generate_reach_forecast,
AudienceInsightsService.generate_insights_finder_report,
CustomerService.create_customer_client, BatchJobService,
ExperimentService, ShareablePreviewService or
KeywordPlanIdeaService.generate_keyword_forecast_metrics.

Many methods change the account. Methods that support it accept
`validate_only: true` in the request to check it without applying it.

request.description:
The request message as a dict with snake_case field names
and enum values as strings. Include `customer_id` where the
request has one (digits only).

Lists the Google Ads API services and methods available to `call_service`.

Without arguments returns every service and its methods. With `service`
(e.g. "ConversionUploadService") also returns the request fields of each
method, so you can build a request for `call_service`. Full request
documentation is at
https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/reference/rpc/latest/overview
